description.text: Introduction This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in Civil and Environmental Engineering, familiar with the latest developments in the field of Civil Engineering of the modern world. Areas of Study for a Master of Science Degree ·Geotechnical Engineering ·Structural Engineering ·Bridge and Tunnel Engineering Main Courses Numerical Analysis, Advanced Engineering Mathematics, Engineering Elasticity and Plasticity, Fundamental of Material Science and Engineering, Finite Element Method, Advanced Soil Mechanics, Geotechnical Engineering, Analysis and Design of Foundations, Geotechnical Earthquake Engineering, Structural Engineering, Advanced Concrete Structures, Structural Dynamics, Steel-Concrete Composite Structures, etc. Curriculum Schedule Laboratory equipment and supply(click the pics to enlarge) Laboratory equipment of BUCEA Laboratory equipment ofBUCEA Laboratory equipment ofBUCEA General Characteristics The Master of Science program in Civil and Enviroment Engineering has the following objectives: ·Graduate preparation for further study in engineering, leading to the Ph.D. or Doctor of Engineering degree ·Job-entry education for the more complex areas of engineering, such as research and development, innovative design, systems analysis and design, and managerial engineering Social Practice Activities for International Students(click the pics to enlarge) International Students' acctivities International Students' acctivities Requirements for this Program Graduate students are required to complete 30 units coursework, a thesis research project or design and an oral defense administered by a panel of faculty. With the Graduate Coordinator's approval, students will be expected to select their elective units in one of the following areas of study: Geotechnical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Bridge and Tunnel Engineering. The duration of M.S Program is 3 years. Seminar inBeijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture Degree Awarded Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering Internship Graduate students are required to take the Practical Training more than 240 hours in firms or laboratory Career You will be able to find great jobs in the field of housing construction, tunnel and underground construction, bridge construction and mine companies.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of undergraduate school 5.Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents 7.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2.Be Healthy. 3.Above the age of 20 and under the age of 35 4.Have attained Bachelor Degree with good marks. 5.Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China.
